title: AID Protocol v2 — SemanticReview
description: Artifact emitted by C2 (semantic reviewer) after running lens-based semantic analysis across one or more review modes.

allOf.$comment: extends aid-protocol-v2.schema.json envelope (reference only — not a resolved $ref)

semantic_review.$comment: enforced — minimal payload; full schema defined in owning phase (E5). All properties below are optional at top level (D5 observe/best-effort compat); finding fingerprint computed as: fingerprint <project_id> semantic_review <check_id> <target_path> <finding_class> via scripts/lib/aid-finding-fingerprint.sh

profile_hash.$comment: hash of the review-profile used for this run (for E3 invalidation)

lenses_run.$comment: lens identifiers that were applied in this review run

items.$comment: finding fingerprint = sha256(project_id + 'semantic_review' + check_id + target_path + finding_class) via aid-finding-fingerprint.sh

fingerprint.$comment: envelope-consistent fingerprint; input: project_id semantic_review check_id target_path finding_class

check_id.$comment: input to fingerprint(); identifies the specific check within the lens

target_path.$comment: input to fingerprint(); file or component path being evaluated

finding_class.$comment: input to fingerprint(); semantic category of the finding

merge_meta.$comment: populated when this artifact is the result of a deterministic lossless merge of multiple mode-specific reviews

merged_from.$comment: source semantic-review JSON file paths that were merged

c1_evidence_ref.$comment: path to C1 evidence artifact used as input to this C2 review

dispatch_observed.$comment: wiring-gate observe signal: records which modes were dispatched (observe/best-effort, E5)

modes_count.$comment: count of modes_dispatched for quick aggregation
